articles.title: U.S.- China AI race heats up as Chinese rivals secure billions ahead of IPOs
articles.snippet: DeepSeek and Moonshot attract fresh capital ahead of planned listings, while OpenAI courts major investors.

articles.title: OKX looks to abstract blockchain mechanics to bring stablecoin balances to everyday consumers
articles.snippet: OKX appears to be designing products to keep the blockchain element abstracted or out of sight for users who simply want to hold digital dollars and use a card.

articles.title: Capital starting to rotate back to crypto from AI: Raoul Pal
articles.snippet: Real Vision founder Raoul Pal says a pause in the AI stock rally could help crypto attract capital, while AI agents are likely to boost Ethereum and Solana adoption.

articles.title: Polymarket overhauls smart contracts with new Protocol V2 rollout
articles.snippet: Polymarket begins its Protocol V2 rollout ahead of a planned November transition for new prediction markets, while existing positions remain on the current system.

articles.title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
articles.snippet: ZachXBT says he infiltrated the network by posing as a customer, gaining information that helped trace funds from the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.
